review_description: After Clean NRG gave me a quote, and I paid a substantial deposit (>$2000) I was looking forward to getting my battery.  This was in August 2025.  When I did not hear from them, I contacted them twice in the next two and a half months but was told that they were working on my case.  Finally they told me that their installer could not do it.  I have lost a lot of time and may be too late to get the federal and state subsidies.  Although they returned my deposit, I did not get any compensation for the months that they had held my money.  Very dissatisfied with poor communication and poor customer service.

Clean NRG actually took the time to understand what I wanted, while other quotes felt more like what the vendor wanted to sell.  Other vendors were pushing me towards a tesla charger, but the result would have been disappointing.Installation is reasonable.  Took longer than they estimated and not as tidy as it could have been, but overall ok.System performance is excellent, especially the charger/inverter integration.

Clean NRG were one of the three firms recommended by solar quotes to replace an old 1.7kW solar system with a new, battery-ready 6.6kW system. They were a pleasure to work with from start to finish. Prompt, detailed quotes and equipment information followed by a very quick installation turnaround time. This was completed by a very professional installation team. So far, so good. The system is pumping out exactly what it's supposed to. Very highly recommended, 5 stars for every stage of the process.

We installed solar through Clean NRG two years ago. Since then, the system has saved us a lot of money and has been worth it. Craig and Tony have been very helpful with follow up. Recently, our inverter had an issue. Craig came out and found a dead gecko in the fan. I was advised a fee of $180 - $200 would apply for a call out but Craig fixed the issue free of charge. Extremely grateful for this generous and prompt customer service. Thank you so much Craig and Tony!
I was recently contacted as my Inverter was overheating and as I was away working Craig from Clean NRG came out free of charge and unblocked the air vents. Great customer service!

I cant recommend Clean NRG Pty Ltd enough for their after installation service. Our Inverter is about 3 years old and an alarm was alerting them of a problem with it and they came out to check to see what the issue was when I wasn't able to successfully test the unit. Cant thankyou enough and thanks for  looking after us cheers Sue
Sales person was prompt and well informedInstaller was punctual, polite, tidy and informativeAll the paper work and approvals with Western power was handled well.

Yes, we went ahead with solar install.Based on SQ’s great online info and SQ’s recommended solar firms, we’d give SQ max star rating!Found SQ’s online info precise informative useful and very helpful, together with SQ’s quick responses and very good follow up's.SQ suggested three firms … one did not respond to enquiry.Of the other two we chose CleanNRG, and cannot speak highly enough of them - an immediate site visit, and liked the rep’s attitude interest and knowledge.Recvd a 1st quote that covered everything in excellent detail, then two more good site visits by CleanNRG’s proposed installer to check onsite because cable & inverter installation was complex, not straight forward.Various phone conversations subsequently happened with CleanNRG discussing & considering options, always helpful, quote then slightly revised and accepted.CleanNRG wanted to use their top team due to the complexity, so a small time delay before work carried out.The install team (Peter, Zack, Adam of Wise Electrical) were absolutely brilliant - arrived on time, pleasant & polite, all reqd install materials neatly ready in trailer, worked a very long day, willing to discuss anything, considerate of us and house and surrounds, efficient  … work was quality, clean, neat & workmanlike, done with a minimum of disturbance.Finally, at the end of the work day, immediate connection into the PV / grid, and we had a fully functioning solar system, working as hoped!Couldn’t ask for more!

The contractor brought his 11 year old child to the install. The 11 year old child was seen on my roof carrying solar panels.The installers (probably the 11 year old child on my roof) broke approximately 25 roof tiles. Some were replaced but most were glued with silicone. This lead to water damage over the following 15 months.The damaged tiles which were replaced were left for me to clean.The arrays are not straight. The panels have not been levelled.The cut out in our meter box was done incorrectly and was only covered with a sticker after we raised a complaint.No dektites or appropriate flashings have been used, the wires are shoved through a drilled hole in the tile and patched with silicone. It is very likely these will eventually leak. The conduit and wires are hanging and have not been fixed in place.The smart meter was installed incorrectly and had to be reinstalled.The inverter has a proprietary plug (MODBUS) where the smart meter connects, most of those connections have been pushed in too far with a screw driver causing damage.The installers left graffiti on my recycling bin. They wrote "F*** YOU" on the top of the bin.The install was over $7k for a 5kw inverter. I have seen advertisements elsewhere for the same system at a lower price, and its highly likely those other installers will not put an 11 year old child on your roof causing water damage.

The customer service was great and they really worked with me to get the best result. The quote process was a breeze and much better than other quotes I received, including more detail. Instalation was on time and completed on the day they said it would occur. Very happy and the quote was I felt really competative apart from the slight increase from the original quote to the final quote.

Clean NRG have been efficient, helpful and friendly from the start of this process.  They have provided useful advise without attempting to upswell or over service our requirements.  I am happy to recommend Clean NRG to any prospective solar power purchaser.
The process was simple. They delivered on what they said they would. The install team were very professional. All my questions were answered promptly.

Clean NRG provided a good quote and delivered on the products quoted. The installers were polite and tidy but under the pump. Although working, the commissioning of the system was less thorough than expected.

The team at cleanNRG were honest and transparent throughout the entire sales process regarding the most appropriate system for our needs. Offered quality products from the get go rather than pushing cheaper equivalents.Their outsourced installers were also fantastic, overcoming some on the day install complexities. Very clean, polite and professional.Our system is now up and running and after the first few days, production far exceeds our expectations! Consumption meter well worth the extra investment too.
All three suppliers that provided quotes were helpful and knew their products. It was a hard choice!
Clean NRG were quick, competent and efficient. Communication was good and the team did a great job.

Everthing was arranged by NRG, great contact via phone and email. Install was top notch.Slight disagreement about the final balance due to different cells being used but was all worked out.I would recommend them to anyone.
Installation was quick and well done, but final step which means we can use the app to monitor the system still has not been done. (Nov)

I was looking for an Enphase or SolarEdge system due to the strange angles on my roof.The process was very smooth through Clean NRG.  The sales representative had excellent knowledge of all the systems.  Especially when compared to every other company I spoke to that was recommended by Solar Quotes. One didn't reply, one said the roof was impossible and the other one had a sales person who knew less about micro-inverters than me (he even said he would come back to me after the Christmas break and he never did).The solar rebate was properly handled.It was understood our roof was quite challenging.When it came to installation I was amazed that the installation was going to be done by 1 person for 25 panels on a tiled roof.  The initial estimate was 5 days and that blew out to 12 days with constant excuses, I suspect it was a combination of multiple jobs, doing it solo, an extra hot week.Beyond that, the installer kept bringing up the cost of adding some timber here and there, adding a switchboard, outside of the price of what the company estimate was.I am still waiting on the final stickers to go on the switch board and getting access to the monitoring software.It was primarily a problem because our switchboard is wired to be inside the house so we have to be at home while the installation was going on.

No regrets with Clean NRG.I researched for months obtaining many quotes and listening to a lot of BS from dodgy sales people a long the way.Save yourself time and call Clean NRG.Fantastic service, honest advice and very neat installation.
Was quite  straight forward. They were responsive to my questions  It was  a hassle free process.
Quoting and discussion was great.  Installation went well, installers very polite and obliging.  Every Aspect was handled by Solar Company, I haven't organised anything.

The system is working well and we're looking forward to seeing the effect on our next electricity bill.

A great company with high quality products and a very quick turnaround. He whole process was made so simple I didn’t really have to do anything. I would definitely recommend this company.
Excellent, courteous, sales staff. Great technical information. Unbeatable price. Arranged installation on short notice, despite it being a busy period.  All my expectations have been exceeded.

Good service, national rated company, neat install

Our experience with Clean NRG started off great. We did our research and they came up as being one of the better installers. We had a quote done about 6 years ago and were told, due to our roof pitches and the buildings around we would struggle to get a viable system. However, we thought we would give it another go, given advancements in technology. My partner explained our concerns to Tony very clearly from the start, a number of times we requested that someone come out and get on the roof to do a measure up before proceeding with any deposits, applications to synergy etc.  However, after a few requests and phone conversations we were told the only way it would progress would be to send in a copy of our bill, which we did, as by now we were pretty confident with what Tony was telling us. After this point we were trying to get answers, appointments etc. but responses were hard to get. Tony eventually visited, had a look at the meter, but did not get on the roof, next thing our meter is being changed over to a new meter, still no one has gotten on the roof.  Eventually someone was sent to measure up and a few days later we got a call to book in the install, by now the original quote of 12 panels (using google maps) had gone to 10 panels, but we decided to proceed. Day of installation came and by now a deposit had been paid and the installer got on the roof and after a bit of a look around told us that he was unable to install, as we could only get 8 panels and they would need to be split in such a way the inverter would not work on 1 section. After a long conversation with the installer and Tony, we were told to give Clean NRG a week to see if they could come up with a design (as in their words, they wanted to be able to salvage something). We waited for the call back, and received nothing, about 2 weeks later I called and spoke to Tony, first he denied saying he would call back and said that he was waiting on us, as we were going to modify our patio (this was briefly mentioned with the installer, however the installer advised against it as the power we would generate compared to the cost of install and modifying the patio (which would undermine the warranty) were going to result is a product we were not happy with), he then questioned whether I had paid a deposit, when I asked for a refund, and lastly, when we brought up the fact that the meter was read and changed (which we are now out of pocket about $200) he claimed Clean NRG had nothing to do with it. Yet when I called Synergy they said that the application was from a third party called Clean NRG. On top of that we were told that the guy that did the measure up, doesn't have much experience, hence the problems.All in all we now have a $200 Synergy bill with 0 to show for it, other than frustration. I would not recommend them to anyone who has a difficult roof space to work with.Sorry for the long post
